necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and presyncope in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome (I49.5) and atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate-control management. This specific monitoring is required to address the clinical indication of correlating symptoms with arrhythmias, which justifies the medical necessity despite the missing prior authorization.
